connector.name: Certindex MCP
connector.registryDescription: Certificate Transparency search for AI agents: certs, subdomains, issuance history, expiry.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package certindex-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the certindex account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
